designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the Secretary of the Interior to acquire Habre-de-Venture, the Maryland home of Declaration signer Thomas Stone, for Thomas Stone National Historic Site.
designationHistory.note: Sec. 510(b) called for formal establishment by Federal Register notice once enough land was owned; that notice was not located.
